name: Continue Your Training
summary: Newly risen Forsaken paladins leave Deathknell for instruction in Brill. Aramis Hammerhand sends them east into Tirisfal Glades, where dangers and distrust await those who wield the Holy Light.

sections.title: Leaving Deathknell
sections.body: After learning martial combat and channeling holy power in Deathknell's graveyard, you are sent east into Tirisfal Glades. Your destination is Brill, the regional outpost and administrative hub for central Tirisfal. There, Shari Stilwell oversees the training of those who follow the path of the paladin in undeath.

sections.title: A Precarious Calling
sections.body: Aramis offers parting advice about the peril of being an undead paladin. Lordaeron still needs defenders against threats from beyond, yet wielding the Holy Light under Sylvanas Windrunner's banner draws suspicion. Many Forsaken suffered agony or death at the hands of holy zealots, and the Light's presence breeds distrust among their undead kin.

faq.q: Who gives this quest and where do I find them?
faq.answer: Aramis Hammerhand, the paladin trainer in Deathknell, gives it to you.

faq.q: Where do I turn in Continue Your Training?
faq.answer: You bring it to Shari Stilwell, the paladin trainer in Brill, east along the main road from Deathknell.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken distrust paladins?
faq.answer: Many Forsaken resent the Holy Light for the agony it causes undead bodies and for persecution by holy orders such as the Scarlet Crusade. A paladin walks close to forces many undead fear or despise.

faq.q: Can any Forsaken class take this quest?
faq.answer: No. It is for Forsaken paladins leaving Deathknell for Brill and the wider world.
Brill is a town in central Tirisfal Glades and a hub for Forsaken travelers, guards, and tradesfolk, just north of the Undercity ruins.

faq.q: What threats does Lordaeron face according to Aramis?
faq.answer: Aramis warns that Lordaeron faces rampaging Scourge remnants, hostile wildlife, and vengeful living factions such as the Scarlet Crusade.

angles.text: As an undead paladin, you may find that wielding holy power leaves you an outsider among your fellow Forsaken.
As an Undead, you live with tensions between loyalty to Lordaeron's soil and the lingering trauma of the Holy Light.
